summary: AUSTRHEIM MELK DA (org. no. 986 132 813) is a partnership with shared liability (DA) based in Vindafjord, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2003-10-16. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 01.410 (Melkeproduksjon på storfe og oppdrett av melkekyr); it has 0 registered employees. CEO: Torleif Stople.
